title: Dead max_sample_age_s fixture in existing DIO tracker test
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:395-398 (pre-existing, in reviewed range): max_sample_age_s=30 and clock.set(100) are dead fixture values for the asserted outcome — the sample was already claimed by authorized.adopt(sample) at line 382, so verifier._claim returns None and _adopt_locked rejects 'sample-already-considered' (stratum.py:605-607) before any age check fires. The config misleads readers into thinking age rejection is covered there.
